tools.name: lookup_restrictions
tools.description:
Look up recorded deed restrictions for a Texas parcel.

    `address`: a street address (e.g. "6310 Needham Ln, Austin TX 78739"; case, suffix
    spelling, city/state/ZIP are tolerated) or a parcel id (Travis: TCAD prop_id / geo_id; Hays: HAYS-<prop_id>).
    Returns parcel info, applicable documen

tools.name: get_clauses
tools.description:
Get restriction clauses applying to a parcel (prop_id or geo_id as returned by lookup_restrictions), optionally
    filtered by topic: units_per_lot, single_family, setbacks, use, short_term_rental, fences,
    accessory_buildings, min_size, duration_renewal, amendment_process, other.
    Superseded

tools.name: get_document
tools.description:
Get a recorded document's metadata (instrument no., volume/page, recorded date,
    enforcer, source URL, amendment chain), its scope rows, and its extracted clauses.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description:
Which record sources have been searched (and with what result) for a parcel's
    subdivision or for a subdivision name, e.g. "Circle C Ranch Phs B Sec 2".
